statement: Median per-capita disposable income growth < mean growth in 2027 annual data (national statistics office; one indicator per leading jurisdiction)
status_at_phase_end: Bloc B statistics office: median growth below mean growth in 2025 annual data (4.4% vs 5.0%) and in every cumulative 2026 release after Q1 (H1 4.7% vs 5.2%; Jan-Sep 4.6% vs 5.3%); Q1 2026 was the exception (5.0% vs 4.9%). Bloc A has no directly comparable per-capita median/mean disposable-income growth pair in its annual release.

items.summary: Bloc B 2025 annual household survey: median per-capita disposable income +4.4% nominal vs mean +5.0%; median equal to 83.5% of mean. Median growth below mean growth (urban median +3.7% vs urban mean +4.3%).
items.detail: Bloc B NBS 2025 residents' income and consumption release (2026-01-19): mean 43,377 yuan (+5.0% nominal), median 36,231 yuan (+4.4%). Read via People's Daily Online reprint of the NBS release.

items.summary: Bloc B Q1 2026: median per-capita disposable income +5.0% vs mean +4.9% - median slightly faster than mean (median/mean ratio 81.6%).
items.detail: Bloc B NBS Q1 2026 income release (2026-04-16): mean 12,782 yuan (+4.9%), median 10,433 yuan (+5.0%). Read via reprint on Bloc B Real Estate Association site citing NBS.

items.summary: Bloc B H1 2026: median per-capita disposable income +4.7% vs mean +5.2%; median/mean ratio 82.8%.
items.detail: Bloc B NBS H1 2026 income release (2026-07-15), mean 22,981 yuan, median 19,036 yuan.

items.summary: Bloc B Jan-Sep 2026: median per-capita disposable income +4.6% vs mean +5.3%; gap widened to 0.7 pp; property income +1.6% vs wage income +5.3%.
items.detail: Bloc B NBS Q1-Q3 2026 income release (2026-10-19): mean 34,230 yuan, median 28,388 yuan (82.9% of mean); urban median +3.9% vs urban mean +4.5%.

items.summary: Bloc A annual income report for 2025: real median household income +2.6% to a record level. The release reports household (not per-capita disposable) income, so it does not map directly onto the median-vs-mean per-capita test.
items.detail: Bloc A Census Bureau, Income in the Bloc A: 2025 (P60-289), released 2026-09-15: median household income $87,460 vs $85,210 in 2024. Mean comparison not extracted.

items.summary: No Bloc A official series publishes per-capita disposable-income median and mean growth side by side; a comparable Bloc A series must be constructed (e.g. from household-survey microdata or distributional national accounts).
items.detail: Bloc A Census CPS ASEC reports household money income (pre-tax); BEA distribution of personal income is a prototype series. Neither is a direct equivalent of the Bloc B NBS per-capita disposable median/mean pair.
